name: assay
description: Blind trial bench for model selection. Runs one workload across every model on the bench in parallel with the names shuffled to letters, scores the anonymised outputs with a blind examiner, measures token cost and latency, then reveals which model earned which column and folds the crown into a personal routing policy.
_comment: Swap tool_id for the minted id: node ../../scripts/set-tool-id.mjs apply --tool <minted-id>. distribution.profiles.local installs on your own machine only and is the dev loop. distribution.profiles.binary is what other users install and is what the Marketplace needs, but its artifacts under build/ do not exist yet, so local is active until they are built. Do not submit for review while local is the active profile.
